Ava / team — did a quick inventory check with infra. Notes: 
- Short-term availability: us-west has 12 A100s across two pools; us-east currently shows 4 A100s free but available A10/NVidia T4 capacity is larger.
- For SierraAI’s profile (mix of 128-token short requests with occasional 8k runs), the primary cost/latency driver is memory footprint for the KV cache. 6x A100s will meet latency targets for the short requests p50; p95 during long-context spikes will likely exceed 200ms unless we split traffic.
- Proposal: Hold 4x A100s as the primary standby and 2x A10-class instances as an overflow that can be used for long-context evaluation with slightly degraded p95. We can also enable aggressive KV prefix caching for short requests to improve p50.

I’ve attached a conservative capacity rundown and an initial cost delta estimate for a 4-week standby vs a 3-month soft-commit. If procurement needs firm numbers for an MOU, Marissa can help convert to a preliminary quote.

Aditya
